honesty_rules: Show only what the record holds; a value the record does not hold renders as absent, never synthesized.
Absence is never zero: unobserved quota readings stay null and are counted as unobserved, not as 0 used.
Executions are a committed-projection proxy (recon gap G3): the Neon lane_events table is not read by this collector and no live run state is claimed.
Workflow run counts are API observations stamped with their read time, not live claims.
Derived values are labeled derived and computed from the source fields named beside them.

actions_corpus.title: Actions run volume — reconstructed corpus (daily increments)
actions_corpus.method: Delta of run_count/total_jobs between consecutive daily docs/ops/generated/actions-performance-reconstructed-*.json files (cumulative, label locally_reconstructed, source_count == run_count). minutes_est = jobs_delta × that day's avg_job_duration_ms / 60000 — an estimate. Corpus grows ~40 runs/day by reconstruction sampling: increments are corpus growth, NOT total fleet Actions volume.
